
Verified reference code from earlier tasks, most relevant first.

Record 1.

entry count_digits
params u64
ret u8

Counts the decimal digits of n; 0 has one digit.

```
fn count_digits n ulong to uchar
k = uchar 1
while ge n 10 bound 20
n = div n 10
k = add k 1
end
ret k
end
```

Record 2.

entry twin_pick
params u8
ret u8

Twin record used for the tie-break test: returns its argument doubled.

```
fn twin_pick x uchar to uchar
ret add x x
end
```
